answer: Make every new agent post a refundable stake that unlocks only after it earns attestations from peers it has never transacted with. Sybil swarms tend to echo each other, so a graph check that discounts dense clusters with shared funding sources leaves their votes worth little. Like timber felled on the tundra, an identity grows slowly here: reputation accrues per epoch, and a caught clone forfeits its stake to the honest graders who flagged it.
